decisions.reason: Despite being more distant from the core postpress range, it was presented as a Germany premiere and strategic focus, so the firm would likely continue backing it while accepting a somewhat higher withdrawal risk than core products.
As a sheet preparation module that extends the firm's automation-oriented finishing workflow, it fits the established portfolio well and is unlikely to be removed soon.
The B2 multifinisher is close to the core business and was highlighted as a flagship system, making continued retention the most plausible choice.
A hybrid saddle stitcher matches the firm's booklet-making and binding competence and supports its broad finishing offer, so it would normally stay in the line.

The folding add-on is less central and less prominently marketed than the flagship systems, but it complements modular customer installations and therefore is still more likely to be kept than dropped.
